item.title: NASA | Introducing Little SDO
item.description: Meet Little SDO! This comically animated version of NASA's Solar Dynamics Observatory is here to introduce you to all the great new ways we'll be looking at the sun and predicting how it will affect our lives on Earth. Learn more about Little SDO's big sister: http://www.nasa.gov/sdo Want more?
